tests/test_fuzz_scan.py (57), tests/test_fuzz_render.py (47), tests/test_fuzz_fold_gitignore.py (13). Found and fixed three real defects: scan.py accepted a duplicated mapping key so a copier.yml with two same-named questions silently lost one; render.py joined the package id onto tools/ with no validation, so '../..' or an absolute path escaped, a NUL byte raised ValueError out of resolve(), and G/ALPHA resolved to g/alpha on a case-insensitive filesystem; fold_gitignore.py raised on a non-UTF-8 fragment, which would trip copier cleanup_on_error and delete the whole render. tests/test_integration.py, 35 tests. Covers four-package composition into one project with per-package answers files, conditional-filename and empty-multiselect branches, actionlint over rendered workflows, lefthook validate/dump over all seven language answer branches, the gitignore fold across packages, idempotence, and both render-contract failure modes. Plus a 14-package live sweep into one project, actionlint clean. Commit 89f07eb.

Fixed in 89f07eb. Owner is every package that ships a .gitignore.d fragment: each runs a byte-identical tasks/fold_gitignore.py (python, ts, go, rust, terraform, agent-hooks, starlight). A copier template cannot reference a sibling package's files, so the duplicated copy is the mechanism; test_every_copy_is_identical pins them against drift. The script rewrites its own delimited block, so it is idempotent and render-order independent.

Fixed in fae4fe2, both halves. Ownership: create-vite and nuxi run BEFORE foundation/base, which the new-project runbook now states -- previously ts/package.md carried the commands but the render order said base first, so the scaffold would hit a non-empty directory. No scaffold-first package variant was needed. Flags verified live: nuxi@3 needs --template, --force, and --gitInit=false together (it exits 0 after printing a prompt it could not ask, so a missing flag reads as success); sst@4 init --yes skips the confirmation only, its provider question still prompts and it exits 1 without writing, so sst is documented as user-run. Also found and fixed a defect while probing: create-vite 9 scaffolds vanilla for an unrecognised --template instead of failing, so vite_template is now an enum of its nine TypeScript templates, pinned by test_vite_template_rejects_a_name_create_vite_does_not_have.

All 7 children closed. Shipped: root-level single-skill APM package, setup only, no reproduce path. 35 packages in 9 groups, scan.py --lint-only clean, 153 tests passing (unit + hypothesis fuzz + live integration renders). Head d80241d, pushed to bailiff-io/bailiff main.

Five real defects found by the fuzz and live-render halves, none of which the lint gate could see: duplicate YAML key in scan.py; path traversal in render.py (case-variant and NUL-byte package ids resolved to real directories, and a symlink out of tools/ rendered); .gitignore.d fragments were never folded into .gitignore, so every pattern was inert; a non-UTF-8 fragment raised out of the fold task, which under cleanup_on_error deletes the whole render; and .hooks.d fragments were written in pre-commit's schema, so lefthook merged an array, reported 'Value is array but should be object', and ran no hooks. Both fragment defects were silent -- only running the real consumer (git, lefthook validate/dump) exposed them.

Open follow-up, not blocking: install_hooks: true is untested on a machine without a global core.hooksPath (git-defender occupies it here).
